Class Personal

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.user.User
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.user.Personal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Buddy
public class Personal extends User
Extended user model carrying personal profile data: SID, mobile number, nickname, impresa (signature), carrier info, SMS online status, and current presence state.

3.0.0
